departure.location: Any City in The play area

arrive.location: Any City in The play area

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area
 ![](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif)
featured.rule:

* All standard Arcade server rules apply unless stated below. Rules marked with an asterisk on the Official [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) do not apply.

* Participants are prohibited from leaving the starting cities until an Event Manager has announced the event has begun.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!

today.name: Coffee-Spedition 9th anniversary
today.description:
# PL:  
Drodzy kierowcy,  
    
Z okazji 9 lat istnienia Coffee-Spedition mamy zaszczyt zaprosić Was na nasz konwój urodzinowy. Minione lata były wyjątkowe, więc przeżyjmy tamte dobre chwile po raz kolejny.  
  
## Jak dołączyć do wydarzenia?  
Jeśli jesteś członkiem VTC i chciałbyś dołączyć ze swoją firmą, proszę otwórz ticket na naszym discordzie. Tam przekażemy Ci wszelkie informacje, oraz wyznaczymy miejsce, z którego Twoja firma będzie startować.  

Jeśli nie jesteś zrzeszony w VTC, lub chciałbyś pojawić się osobiście to poprostu wejdź na serwer w dniu wydarzenia i zajmij slot publiczny  
## Szczegóły wydarzenia:  
Data: 24 października 2026  
Godzina zbiórki: 19:00  
Godzina wyjazdu: 20:00  
Start: Frankfurt nad Menem (sloty)  
Miejsce docelowe: Antwerpia (Port kontenerowy)  
Komunikacja głosowa z innymi uczestnikami wydarzenia będzie odbywać się na discordzie Coffee-Spediton: https://discord.gg/c2EQMtpnd6  
### Dodatkowe informacje:  
- Na końcu wydarzenia każdy uczestnik zostanie poproszony o porzucenie/odstawienie naczepy i ustawienie się w miejscu docelowym samym ciągnikiem.  
# EN:  
Dear Virtual Truckers,  

Coffee-Spedition is celebrating its 9th anniversary. It was a great period of time for us and we'd like to invite you to our special convoy.  

## How to join our event?  
If you're a member of a VTC and would like to join with your company, please head to our discord and contact us using the ticket system. We'll provide you with all the necessary information and assign your company a starting slot.  
If you are not a member of a VTC or would like to join personally, simply join our server on the day of the event and take a public slot.  
## Event details: 
Date: 24 October 2026  
Meetup Time: 7:00 PM  
Departure Time: 8:00 PM  
Start: Frankfurt am Main (slots)   
Destination: Antwerp (Container port)  
Voice communication with other truckers and event staff will take place on Coffee-Spediton's discord server: https://discord.gg/c2EQMtpnd6 (main communication language is polish)  
### Additional information:  
- At the end of the event, each participant will be asked to dismiss/leave their trailer and line up at the destination with their truck only.

## Sloty / Slots: Frankfrut am Main (IKA)
![](https://i.imgur.com/Ck8CRjC.jpeg)
## Slot Publiczny / Public Slot: Frankfurt am Main (Transinet)
![](https://i.imgur.com/sYLaLww.png)

🚫 ZAKAZ WYPRZEDZANIA — jedziemy jako jedna ekipa, bez samotnych rajdów.

📏 ZACHOWUJ ODSTĘP — bez wjeżdżania koledze w naczepę. Bezpieczna odległość = spokojna głowa.
🚦 STOSUJ SIĘ DO OGRANICZEŃ — znaki, sygnalizacja i sytuacja na drodze mają pierwszeństwo przed regulaminem konwoju.
🔗 NIE ROZRYWAMY KONWOJU — jeśli grupa się rozciągnie, zwalniamy i czekamy na tył.

🌊 PROMY I PRZEJAZDY — wszyscy stosują się do instrukcji organizatora i obsługi przepraw.
👑 NAJWAŻNIEJSZA ZASADA: DOJEŻDŻAMY RAZEM.

upcoming.description:
## FROM GREENLAND LABS TROUGH ICELANDIC COUNTRYSIDE!
- Z Grónských laboratoří napříč Islandským venkovem!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/x4GPWgq.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is restricted for the any Chemicals etc. (under 10t) - no heavy cargo.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:00** - Meet at the parking slots in Nuuk.
*  **18:30**  - Departure from the Nuuk towards ferry.
*  **18:45**  - Onobarding Ferry towards Iceland. 
*  **18:55**  - Departure from the Ferry towards heart of Iceland.
*  **20:00** -  Passage around the Akureyri City.
*  **20:20** - Arrival to the first Icelandic Secret Road.
*  **20:50** - Arrival to the second Icelandic Secret Road.
*  **21:20** - Final group photo and end of the convoy.



![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/E8u0tfy.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Nuuk, Any Company - Höfn í Hornafirði, MS Stein.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## ALL SLOTS - NUUK

![](https://i.imgur.com/WKn9GFM.jpeg)


*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*

4. 平稳驾驶，尊重车队里每一位驾驶员。希望所有玩家享受联运，一同拍摄精彩截图与视频。

本次活动旨在以车会友，和各个 VTC 交流互动，在欧洲公路上共同创造难忘的编队回忆。

Event Rules:

1. Every driver must comply with TruckersMP official regulations and obey the command of our event marshals at all times during the convoy.
2. Maintain adequate safe distance between vehicles. Ramming, griefing, cutting in and aggressive overtaking are strictly prohibited.
3. All participants are suggested to join our voice channel ahead of schedule for event briefing. If you arrive late, please wait for safe space and merge into the end of the convoy.
4. Please drive calmly and respect every driver in the team. We hope all players enjoy the convoy and capture fantastic screenshots and videos.

This event aims to make friends through trucking, exchange experience with different VTCs, and create amazing convoy memories together on European roads.
